resources.string: Date, with a simple expressive look
Shows the day, date, or date + month as a normal notification icon in the status bar. Lightweight and designed to work without root, Xposed, Accessibility, overlays, or Shizuku.
Turn calendar information in the status bar on or off.
Allow Statusbarplus to bypass battery optimization so the notification and midnight update are less likely to be delayed by the system.
Choose the information to display. This only changes the notification icon content.
Choose system, light, or dark appearance.
Active • using an Android status-bar notification
Statusbarplus uses a normal Android notification icon. The final notification slot position, spacing from the clock, tint, and scaling remain controlled by System UI.

1. Turn on “Show in status bar”.

2. Choose day, day + date, or date + month.

3. Adjust text size and layout if needed.

4. Choose the system font or import your own TTF/OTF font.

5. If your device often stops background apps, allow the battery-optimization exemption. This is optional.
Use the system font or import one TTF/OTF font of your choice.
The selected file is not a valid TTF/OTF font.
Adjust offset, padding, and line spacing inside the notification icon. The slot position relative to the clock cannot be controlled by the app.
